title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Late-Notice Credit: Amount and Entry
content:
**Patient accounts credit memorandum — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The late-notice credit on a room-and-board charge — the agreement's charge whose span begins latest, the one posted first where two begin on the same day — is figured as follows.

1. **Amount.** The late-notice credit equals the late-notice days less the late-notice leave days, never below zero, times the gap between the late-notice billed rate and the late-notice earlier rate; the whole is never below zero and is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure. Where it is zero, no entry is made.
2. **Entry.** The credit is entered against that charge from the first day of its span, with the late-notice days less the late-notice leave days, never below zero, as its day count.
3. **When the new rate took effect for the agreement.** On the later of the current schedule's effective date, 1 July 2026, and the rate notice delivery date plus the rate change notice days; where no notice is recorded, the new rate has not taken effect.
4. **Late-notice days.** The days of the charge's span that fall before the effective date of the current private pay schedule, counted from the first day of the span and never more than the span's days.
5. **Late-notice leave days.** None.
6. **Rates.** The late-notice billed rate is the current schedule's daily rate for the agreement's own tier; the late-notice earlier rate is the preceding schedule's daily rate for the agreement's own tier.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Hypothetical worked example.** An agreement in the Private Suite with Sitting Area whose 31-day span for May 2026 was billed at the current rate of 514.00: every day of that span falls before 1 July 2026, so the late-notice days are 31; leave days none; 31 times the gap of 17.00 (514.00 less 497.00) is 527.00, entered from 1 May 2026 with a day count of 31.

A charge whose span begins on or after the effective date has no late-notice days, and its credit is zero: no entry.
